desc: Redraw this chestnut hedgehog as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic hedgehog proportions, same face, brown spines, cream face, small leaf on the spines, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on spine tips and leaf, subtle spine shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
